title: Dimension formula for finite type schemes
statement:
Let $K$ be a field, $X$ a scheme of finite type over $K$, and
$x\in X$. Then

$$
\kundim_xX=\kundim\mathcal O_{X,x}+\operatorname{trdeg}_K\kappa(x).
$$

(*Source:* Stacks Project, Morphisms, Lemma 29.29.1,
[Tag `02FX`](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02FX),
applied to $X\to\Spec(K)$.)
blueprint_proof_text: This is the recorded classical input named in the statement, Stacks Project, Morphisms, Lemma 29.29.1 ([Tag 02FX](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02FX)), applied to the structure morphism of the scheme of finite type over the field: the dimension of the local ring plus the transcendence degree of the residue field computes the dimension at a point. No separate proof is given.
